title: GM Crops and Their Social Impact — Oxford College, Bengaluru
teaser: Eminent American molecular biologist Nina Fedoroff gave a lecture on 'GM crops and their social impact' to students of Oxford College, Bengaluru, followed by a guided tour of the C V Raman Museum at RRI.
homepageMatter: Eminent American molecular biologist Nina Fedoroff, known for her research in life sciences and biotechnology, gave a lecture on 'GM crops and their social impact' to students of Oxford College, Bengaluru, on 26 November 2018. The students also visited the C V Raman Museum at RRI.
